Class Action Results

Join A Securities Class Action

Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP is a Los Angeles, California plaintiffs' law firm with 35 years of experience representing investors in securities fraud class actions in federal courts nationwide. The firm secured a $433.5 million settlement against Alibaba in In re: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. Securities Litigation, recognized by the Daily Journal CLAY Awards (2026) as the top securities class action result of the year — with attorneys Kara M. Wolke, Robert V. Prongay, and Melissa C. Wright honored for that achievement. The firm was also named Law360's Securities Group of the Year (2025) and a Daily Journal Top Boutique in California for Securities Litigation, Los Angeles (2025).
